aiPanel.geminiIsAnOptionalCloud: Gemini is an optional cloud AI from Google. If you turn it on:
aiPanel.forTheJobsYouSet: For the jobs you set to Gemini, your questions, the chat so far and any screenshots are sent to Google and processed on Google's servers, which may be outside your country.
aiPanel.googleRequiresYouToBe: Google requires you to be 18 or older. In the EU/EEA, Switzerland and the UK, Google's terms ask for a paid (billing-enabled) API key in apps like this.
aiPanel.youCanTurnGeminiOff: You can turn Gemini off any time. GameMate then deletes your key.
aiPanel.ifYouTurnOnWeb: If you turn on web search:
aiPanel.forQuestionsAboutWhatS: For questions about what's current (the meta, patches, seasons) or what players recommend, and when the wiki doesn't have the answer, GameMate or the AI makes a short search query from the key words of your question and the game's name (for example "Overwatch characters currently meta"). Only that query goes to Google, through Gemini with your API key. Your conversation and screenshots are not sent with it.
aiPanel.searchesCountTowardYourKey: Searches count toward your key's free Google Search allowance; with billing turned on for your key, Google may charge for searches beyond it.
aiPanel.youCanTurnWebSearch: You can turn web search off any time here or in Settings → Privacy & legal.
aiPanel.ifYouTurnOnOnline: If you turn on online lookups:
aiPanel.whenAQuestionIsAbout: When a question is about something in a game, GameMate sends the topic (for example "Ender Dragon") to that game's wiki, and for Minecraft mods the mod's name to Modrinth. Your question itself is not sent.
aiPanel.gamemateDownloadsThePageAnd: GameMate downloads the page and its pictures to show them to you. The wikis see your IP address, like any website you visit, and handle it under their own privacy policies.
aiPanel.youCanTurnLookupsOff: You can turn lookups off any time here or in Settings → Privacy & legal.
aiPanel.everythingRunsOnThisPc: Everything runs on this PC unless you choose Gemini for a job.
aiPanel.watchingYourGameOnGemini: Watching your game. On Gemini this sends screenshots every few seconds, which can use up a free key's limits.
aiPanel.smarterAnswersAndBetterScreen: Smarter answers and better screen understanding, using your own Google API key.
aiPanel.flashModelsAreFastAnd: Flash models are fast and have the most free use.
aiPanel.savedOnThisPcEncrypted: Saved on this PC, encrypted by Windows.
aiPanel.deletesYourKeyAndGoes: Deletes your key and goes back to the local AI.
aiPanel.answersExplainTheDetailsSteps: Answers explain the details, steps and useful tips.
aiPanel.answersGetStraightToThe: Answers get straight to the point in a sentence or three. Turn this on for longer explanations.
aiPanel.letsTheAiReadYour: Lets the AI read your game's wiki (and Modrinth for Minecraft mods) when it isn't sure, for things like bosses, items or building a Nether portal. Only the topic is sent, and answers link to the page and can show its pictures, like maps.
aiPanel.letsTheAiSearchThe: Lets the AI search the web with Google (through Gemini) for patches, strategies and tips the wiki doesn’t cover. Only the search query is sent.
aiPanel.searchesTheWebWithGoogle: Searches the web with Google for what the wiki doesn’t cover. Needs Gemini: turn it on and add your key above first.
aiPanel.googleHandlesThatData: Google handles that data under the <terms>Gemini API terms</terms> and <privacy>Google Privacy Policy</privacy>, not GameMate's. With a free key, Google may use what you send to improve its products and people may review it, except in the EU/EEA, Switzerland and the UK. Don't share personal information.
aiPanel.iM18OrOlder: I'm 18 or older and agree to send this data to Google.
aiPanel.googleSearchesTheWeb: Google searches the web, including forums like Reddit, under the <terms>Gemini API terms</terms> and <privacy>Google Privacy Policy</privacy>. Answers show the pages it used and Google's search suggestions.
aiPanel.autoAddAKeyFirst: Auto (decide per question) (add a key first)
aiPanel.getOneAt: Get one at <link>aistudio.google.com</link>. GameMate checks it with Google before saving it.

gamesPanel.gamemateCanFindYourGames: GameMate can find your games and follow the one you're playing. To do that it:
gamesPanel.looksUpAWikiFor: Looks up a wiki for each game it finds, sending only the game's name to wiki.gg and Fandom.
gamesPanel.readsTheNameOfThe: Reads the name of the program in front while you play, to know which game it is.
gamesPanel.keepsEverythingOnThisPc: Keeps everything on this PC. Turning this off forgets all the games it found.
gamesPanel.rankedOnlineGameAiHelp: Ranked online game: AI help during matches may break its rules
gamesPanel.noWikiFoundPasteIts: No wiki found. Paste its address, e.g. https://…fandom.com
gamesPanel.noProgramsWithAWindow: No programs with a window found. Start your game, then try again.
gamesPanel.gamemateKnowsMinecraftOutOf: GameMate knows Minecraft out of the box. Your other games come from a scan of this PC.
gamesPanel.looksThroughSteamEpicGames: Looks through Steam, Epic Games, Battle.net and Riot, and finds each game's wiki. Run it again after installing a game.
gamesPanel.whenYouPressTheShortcut: When you press the shortcut or the companion is watching, GameMate switches to the game in front.
gamesPanel.turnsDetectionOffAndForgets: Turns detection off and forgets every game GameMate found.
gamesPanel.eachGameSWikiWas: Each game's wiki was found by its name: the liveliest one when there are several. Pick another with Other wikis, or paste any wiki's address with Change.
gamesPanel.competitiveGamesCheckTheGame: Competitive games: check the game's rules before using the companion during ranked matches.
gamesPanel.yourCurseforgeModpacksOnThis: Your CurseForge modpacks on this PC, so answers know which mods you have. With another launcher, GameMate reads the mods of the pack that's running.
gamesPanel.noModpackRunningRightNow: No modpack running right now. Start one, or pick it here.
gamesPanel.readsTheGameLists: Reads the game lists of Steam, Epic Games, Battle.net and Riot on this PC, and your CurseForge Minecraft modpacks, when you click Scan for games.
gamesPanel.allowGamemateToLook: Allow GameMate to look for games on this PC.

generalPanel.anotherAppIsUsingThis2: Another app is using this shortcut, so it is off. Pick a different one.

generalPanel.letsGamemateSeeWhatYou: Lets GameMate see what you're looking at when you ask from the game.
generalPanel.whenGamemateQuitsItFrees: When GameMate quits, it frees the AI model right away so nothing keeps running in the background.
generalPanel.keepsTheInGameShortcuts: Keeps the in-game shortcuts and the companion working. Quit from the tray icon. The AI model is freed after a few idle minutes.
generalPanel.closingTheWindowQuitsGamemate: Closing the window quits GameMate. The in-game shortcuts and the companion stop until you start it again.
generalPanel.languageHelp: For GameMate’s windows and the AI’s answers. Game names and wiki pages stay as they are.

summary.runsOnYourPc: Runs on your PC. No account, no ads, no analytics. The GameMate developers receive nothing from you.
summary.yourScreen: Your screen is only captured when you ask, or while the companion is set to watch your game. Screenshots stay in memory and are never saved to disk.
summary.findingYourGames: Finding your games only happens after you allow it in Settings → Games. Then GameMate reads your launchers' game lists (Steam, Epic Games, Battle.net, Riot), your CurseForge modpacks and the name of the program in front. This stays on your PC; to find wikis, only game names are sent to wiki.gg and Fandom.
summary.yourMicrophone: Your microphone is only used when voice input is on and you press the voice shortcut or 🎤. Speech is turned into text on this PC.
summary.chatsAndTheCompanionLog: Chats and the companion log are kept only while GameMate is open.
summary.onlineFeaturesAreOffUntil: Online features are off until you turn them on: looking things up on your game's wiki or Modrinth (only the topic is sent) and Google Gemini (your questions and screenshots are sent to Google). Downloads happen once, when you ask for them: AI and speech models come from Hugging Face, and GameMate's AI engine from GitHub. Update checks ask GitHub for the latest GameMate version (you can turn them off).

privacyPanel.aLogOfWhatGamemate: A log of what GameMate did (like starting the AI or checking for updates), for finding problems. It never contains your questions or answers and is never sent anywhere.
privacyPanel.geminiTerms: Google Gemini: Gemini API terms and Google Privacy Policy.
privacyPanel.wikiLicenses: Game wikis and Modrinth: each wiki's text is under its own license (shown with every answer that uses it, for example minecraft.wiki), so answers link to the page. Pictures in answers are downloaded from the same wikis and link to their page there.
